title: Transfer Web App groups
description: IAM Identity Center groups granted read-write access through the AWS Transfer Family Web App.

groups.description: Transfer Family Web App access definitions, keyed by a stable logical group name used to derive the default group/<name> S3 prefix.

group.description: Configuration for one IAM Identity Center group using the Transfer Family Web App.

description.description: Human-readable purpose of the Web App group access.

owner.description: Free-text name of the team, service or organisation responsible for the group access.

enabled.description: Whether Terraform should provision grants for this group in the current environment.

expires_on.description: Optional review or expiry date in YYYY-MM-DD format. This is recorded for governance but is not currently enforced by Terraform.

identity_center_group_id.description: Immutable IAM Identity Center group ID. Display-name lookup is deliberately not used because it is not reliable for these groups.

additional_prefixes.description: Additional bucket-relative prefixes granted READWRITE access. Terraform always grants group/<logical-group-name>; do not repeat it here or include leading slashes, trailing slashes or wildcards.

prefix.description: An S3 bucket-relative prefix without a leading slash, trailing slash or wildcard.

example-uploaders.description: Example users uploading files through the Transfer Family Web App
